skill.name: stream-chain
skill.description: Orchestrate sequential multi-agent workflows that pass each step's output into custom or predefined development pipelines.
skill.summary: Build context-aware chains for analysis, refactoring, testing, optimization, and data transformation.
skill.author: ruvnet

security_audit.summary: All 87 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and fenced examples; SKILL.md contains no Ruby backtick execution or executable implementation. The documented design forwards complete outputs into later prompts, creating an indirect prompt-injection boundary. It also persists chain context automatically, which can retain sensitive material.

remediation.issue: Complete prior outputs can carry untrusted instructions into later agents.
remediation.suggestion: Separate data from instructions, sanitize retrieved content, and require approval before downstream agents modify files or execute commands.

remediation.issue: Chain context is persisted without documented privacy controls.
remediation.suggestion: Make persistence optional, redact secrets, restrict storage permissions, and document retention and deletion behavior.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Output Propagates Into Later Prompts
semantic_findings.description: Each step receives complete prior output without documented sanitization or instruction boundaries. Malicious content from files or APIs could redirect later agents.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly states that complete output becomes later context. It does not describe controls that distinguish untrusted data from instructions.

semantic_findings.title: Chain Context Is Persisted Automatically
semantic_findings.description: The skill states that chain context is stored for cross-session use. Sensitive prompts and outputs may remain available without documented retention or access controls.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The automatic persistence behavior and storage location are explicitly documented. No opt-in, redaction, retention, or permission controls are described.

content.value_statement: Complex development tasks often lose context between agents. Stream-Chain passes each step's result forward through custom chains or predefined workflows.
actual_capabilities: Runs custom chains containing two or more ordered prompts.
Executes predefined analysis, refactor, test, and optimize pipelines.
Passes each step's complete output into the next step.
Supports timeout, verbose, and debug options.
Defines reusable custom pipelines in the Claude Flow configuration.
Supports staged code, security, migration, and data-processing workflows.
limitations: Requires an installed and configured Claude Flow command-line environment.
Complete output forwarding can carry unsafe instructions or sensitive data downstream.
Automatic context persistence can retain sensitive material.
The included file documents workflows but does not provide their executable implementation.

use_cases.title: Develop Features in Verified Stages
use_cases.description: Move from requirements through implementation, tests, and final review while preserving context between stages.

use_cases.title: Structure Security Reviews
use_cases.description: Analyze vulnerabilities, rank findings, propose fixes, and produce security test cases in one ordered workflow.

use_cases.title: Transform and Validate Data
use_cases.description: Extract, normalize, validate, and summarize data through separate steps with explicit handoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Stream-Chain command for [goal] with three prompts: analyze the task, complete the work, and verify the result.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Predefined Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Select the best predefined pipeline for [repository goal]. Explain the choice and provide a command with an appropriate timeout and logging level.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use an existing analysis, refactor, test, or optimize workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reusable Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reusable Stream-Chain pipeline for [workflow]. Define ordered prompts, timeout values, expected handoffs, and a final verification step.

prompt_templates.title: Secure an Advanced Chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Stream-Chain workflow for [complex task]. Separate untrusted data, redact sensitive context, require approval before changes, and include recovery checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate a high-impact workflow with security controls.

output_examples.input: Create a chain to review an authentication module.
output: First, map authentication boundaries and trust assumptions.
Next, identify vulnerabilities and rank their impact.
Then, propose focused fixes and security tests.
Finally, verify that the fixes preserve expected behavior.

output_examples.input: Choose a pipeline for improving test coverage.
output_examples.output: Use the test pipeline. It reviews coverage gaps, designs critical cases, and prepares tests with assertions.

output_examples.input: Plan a reusable framework migration workflow.
output: Update selected modules in controlled stages.
Run migration tests and document rollback steps.

best_practices: Use specific prompts and order them so each step has a clear input and outcome.
Add verification and human approval before file changes or command execution.
Limit forwarded context, redact secrets, and choose timeouts appropriate for each step.
anti_patterns: Do not pass untrusted content into later prompts without clear data boundaries.
Do not enable verbose or debug logging when prompts may contain secrets.
Do not chain implementation steps without tests, rollback guidance, or approval gates.

faq.question: What does Stream-Chain do?
faq.answer: It organizes ordered agent prompts and passes each step's output into the next step.

faq.question: Which predefined pipelines are available?
faq.answer: The documentation lists analysis, refactor, test, and optimize pipelines.

faq.question: Can I create a custom chain?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide at least two ordered prompts and optional timeout, verbose, or debug settings.

faq.question: Can I define reusable pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. Define named pipelines and their prompts in the Claude Flow configuration.

faq.question: Does the skill preserve context?
faq.answer: Yes. Complete prior output flows forward, and the documentation states that chain context is persisted.

faq.question: How should I handle sensitive data?
faq.answer: Redact secrets, limit forwarded context, avoid detailed logging, and confirm storage controls before running the chain.
